描述_EN: the finely modelled figure is of the compassionate bodhisattva avalokiteshvara, known in chinese as guanyin. although members of the imperial family were the most prestigious client for tiles, the largest customers by far were the numerous temple complexes all over china. here we see a very thick tile, constructed to provide a niche for the figure of the bodhisattva (an elevated being committed to attaining enlightenment), seated and holding a flask of ambrosia. at least as early as the song dynasty (960-1279), buddhist and daoist temples were using glazed tiles on all their exterior surfaces. originally it would have formed part of a wall of similar tiled images, for its unglazed back has raised ribs grooved to key into adjoining tiles.
描述_ZN: 精细的造型是慈悲的观音菩萨，在中国被称为观世音菩萨。 虽然皇室成员是最有声望的瓷砖客户，但到目前为止，最大的客户是中国各地的众多寺庙群。 这里我们看到一块很厚的瓦片，是为了给菩萨（致力于实现开悟的高人）的形象提供一个龛位，菩萨坐着，手里拿着一壶伏羲。 至少早在宋代（960-1279），佛教和道教的寺庙就在其所有的外表面使用了釉面砖。 最初，它应该是类似瓷砖图像墙的一部分，因为它的无釉背面有凸起的肋骨，可以与相邻的瓷砖对接。
